verdict.rationale:
Maritime documents a cron trigger that wakes an agent on a schedule and delivers a prompt, which is a form of automatic action-on-event, plus outgoing webhooks for lifecycle state changes. However there is no evidence of a general rule/condition engine that lets users define arbitrary 'if event X then action Y' automations beyond time-based cron scheduling.

missing for 10: event-driven triggers beyond cron (e.g. webhook-triggered agent actions), conditional/multi-step rule definitions, and any UI/API for composing custom trigger-condition-action rules.
